name: pi-managed-vendor
description: Vendor bundle for engineering-agents Pi managed packages. Built by nix/modules/pi (npm ci from package-lock.json), combined with fetchFromGitHub-pinned git packages, and compiled into local facades at build time. Maintained by nix/modules/pi/config.nix — do not add ad-hoc dependencies here.
note-git-package-dependencies: Git-sourced managed packages (fetched by Nix, not npm) ship without their own node_modules. Their registry dependencies are declared here so the vendor tree satisfies runtime resolution. typebox is pinned to ^1.1.32 (pi-ext's floor); pi-subagents' exact 1.1.24 pin is satisfied within 1.1.x API compatibility.
